LNG_USER_FIELD_LABEL_REMOVE_OUTBREAK_CON.translation: You are about to remove access to one or more outbreaks. This action will revoke the user's permission for the deselected outbreaks. Are you sure you want to continue?

LNG_OUTBREAK_FIELD_LABEL_ALLOW_QUESTIONN.translation: Allow editing questionnaire answers in bulk modify
When enabled, contact questionnaire answers can be edited as columns on the bulk modify contacts page

LNG_OUTBREAK_FIELD_LABEL_OPTIONAL_CASE_C.translation: Allow registering cases and contacts without a Current address
When enabled, cases and contacts can be saved without an address being filled in
